# Game Idea: Space Dodger

**Genre**: Arcade / Endless runner

**Core Loop**: The player controls a small spaceship that continuously moves forward across an HTML canvas. Asteroids of varying sizes spawn from the right and drift left. The ship can move up/down (or in 2‑D) to avoid collisions.

**Controls**: Arrow keys or WASD to move the ship.

**Win Condition**: Accumulate distance (or points) for as long as possible.

**Lose Condition**: The ship collides with any asteroid – the game ends and the final score is shown.

**Visuals**: Simple shapes (triangles for the ship, circles for asteroids) rendered with Canvas API, making it lightweight and easy to implement.

**Extensions**: Power‑ups (shield, speed boost), increasing asteroid speed over time, high‑score leaderboard.

1: // Space Dodger – simple canvas game
2: // Canvas must have id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.type = 'sine';
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, now + 0.01);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration / 1000);
21:     osc.start(now);
22:     osc.stop(now + duration / 1000);
23:   }
24:   // Set canvas dimensions (full window)
25:   const resize = () => { canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; };
26:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
27:   resize();
28: 
29:   // Ship definition (gradient triangle)
30:   // Starfield background
31:   const stars = [];
32:   const starCount = 200;
33:   function initStars() {
34:     stars.length = 0;
35:     for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
36:       stars.push({
37:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
38:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
39:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
40:       });
41:     }
42:   }
43:   initStars();
44:   // Redraw stars on resize
45:   window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
46:     initStars();
47:   });
48: 
49:   const ship = {
50:   const ship = {
51:     x: 80,
52:     y: canvas.height / 2,
53:     radius: 12,
54:     speed: 4,
55:     dy: 0,
56:     draw() {
57:       // gradient ship
58:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x - this.radius, this.y - this.radius, this.x, this.y + this.radius);
59:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
60:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#00f');
61:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
62:       ctx.beginPath();
63:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
64:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
65:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.radius, this.y - this.radius);
66:       ctx.closePath();
67:       ctx.fill();
68:     },
69:     update() {
70:       this.y += this.dy;
71:       // keep inside canvas
72:       if (this.y < this.radius) this.y = this.radius;
73:       if (this.y > canvas.height - this.radius) this.y = canvas.height - this.radius;
74:     }
75:   };
76: 
77:   // Input handling
78:   const keys = {};
79:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; audioCtx.resume(); updateShipDir(); });
80:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; updateShipDir(); });
81:   function updateShipDir() {
82:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) {
83:       ship.dy = -ship.speed;
84:       playTone(600, 80); // up movement beep
85:     }
86:     else if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) {
87:       ship.dy = ship.speed;
88:       playTone(400, 80); // down movement beep
89:     }
90:     else ship.dy = 0;
91:   }
92: 
93:   // Asteroid pool
94:   const asteroids = [];
95:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
96:   let lastSpawn = 0;
97:   function spawnAsteroid() {
98:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
99:     asteroids.push({
100:       x: canvas.width + size,
101:       y: Math.random() * (canvas.height - size * 2) + size,
102:       r: size,
103:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
104:     });
105:   }
106: 
107:   function updateAsteroids(dt) {
108:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       const a = asteroids[i];
110:       a.x -= a.speed;
111:       if (a.x + a.r < 0) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
112:     }
113:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
114:       spawnAsteroid();
115:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
116:     }
117:   }
118: 
119:   function drawAsteroids() {
120:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
121:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
122:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffb840');
123:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#a00');
124:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
125:       ctx.beginPath();
126:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
127:       ctx.fill();
128:     });
129:   }
130: 
131:   // Simple collision (circle‑to‑triangle bounding circle)
132:   function checkCollision() {
133:     for (const a of asteroids) {
134:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
135:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
136:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
137:       if (dist < a.r + ship.radius) return true;
138:     }
139:     return false;
140:   }
141: 
142:   let score = 0;
143:   let gameOver = false;
144:   let lastTime = 0;
145: 
146:   function loop(timestamp) {
147:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
148:     lastTime = timestamp;
149:     if (gameOver) {
150:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
151:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
152:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
153:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
154:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
155:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
156:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
157:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
158:       return;
159:     }
160:     // draw background (gradient)
161:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
162:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
163:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
164:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
165:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
166:     // update and draw stars (twinkling drift)
167:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:     const starSpeed = 0.3;
169:     stars.forEach(s => {
170:       s.x -= starSpeed;
171:       if (s.x < 0) s.x = canvas.width;
172:       ctx.beginPath();
173:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
174:       ctx.fill();
175:     });
176:     // update
177:     ship.update();
178:     updateAsteroids(dt);
179:     // draw
180:     ship.draw();
181:     drawAsteroids();
182:     // score based on time survived
183:     score += dt * 0.01;
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
185:     ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
186:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
187:     // collision
188:     if (checkCollision()) {
189:       playTone(200, 300); // crash sound
190:       gameOver = true;
191:     }
192:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
193:   }
194: 
195:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196: })();

(End of file - total 196 lines)
</content>
